_: Hand-written half of /commands. build.mjs reads every command and its help text from bin/omabox at omabox's latest release; this file adds a group, a line and examples. A command missing here still shows, under Other. Examples must be valid at that release (omabox help).

up.say: Start a box: headless and invisible unless you ask for a window, any screen size, with your plugins, an isolated network or a save to start from.

down.say: End a box and everything in it. A session's box also goes when its agent exits.

ls.say: Every box: its mode, size, state, network, idle time and plugins. `--json` adds what each one tested: the Omarchy version, the theme, each plugin's commit.

path.say: Where a box lives on disk; its HOME is `<dir>/home`, so you can seed an app's data files there.

mode.say: Show or change a headless box's screen size and refresh rate while it runs.

save.say: Keep a box's HOME (an app signed in, a PIN, a library) so new boxes start from it.

saves.say: List the saves, or delete them.

run.say: Run any command inside a box. `-d` launches an app and returns; `--replace` restarts it after a rebuild. With no box up, a throwaway box runs the command and goes.

shot.say: A PNG of the screen, a region, or one window's own pixels, even covered or on another workspace.

windows.say: The box's windows: where they are, which workspace, what covers them.

wait.say: Wait for a still screen, a window, a layer or a command, instead of sleeping.

log.say: A box's logs: Hyprland's by default, or the shell's, the apps', the last `run -d`'s. `-f` follows them.

events.say: What the box's Hyprland reported, stamped: mark a point, act, then read what came after or wait for one event.

gpu.say: GPU time of one box's processes, to see what your app costs to draw.

keys.say: Key combos for Hyprland binds and the focused app, any Unicode text, or a password from your environment, never on a command line.

click.say: Click in screen, window or screenshot coordinates. `--steps` travels there, hovering what it crosses; `--mod` holds ctrl, shift or alt.

drag.say: Press, move, hold, release: sliders, selections, drag and drop.

pointer.say: Raw pointer moves, button presses, scrolls and pauses, for what `click` and `drag` don't cover.

lua.say: Lua in the box's Hyprland, printing what it returns (tables as JSON).

restart-shell.say: Reload the box's Omarchy shell after you edit a plugin; it says why a plugin did not load.

peek.say: A live, view-only window of any box on workspace 9, opened without taking your focus.

keys-to-box.say: For an interactive box: SUPER keys go to it while its window has focus and the pointer is over it.

clip.say: Your clipboard into an interactive box, once, or the box's back to you. Never for agents.

env.say: Exports that point Wayland tools on your side at a box, so their windows open in it.

host.say: One command on your real desktop, when you asked for it: the one way past the guard, on the record.

config.say: Your settings: where windows open, confirm before closing, the bar icon.

setup.say: Links the agent skill and the bar widget, offers the guard; `--remove` undoes all of it, `--aquamarine` builds aquamarine's fix.

guard.say: Opt in, and agents' shells get a display that doesn't exist: a window they forget to box fails instead of reaching yours.

broker.say: Lets agents inside ai-jail drive boxes of their own, kept to what the jail has.

--version.say: The version, and which aquamarine new boxes use.
